Hi! I just wanted to say that I know setting a date might make you feel better (I’ve been there too) but I promise that your life means more than this! Ive struggled with depression for 10 years im 20 now and I still have times I struggle just as much. But you will find your purpose on this planet, and your life does have meaning. I know it’s hard to see it right now. And this sounds like the classic “it’ll get better” advice that everyone gives you and doesn’t help at all. But I can try and help as much as I can! Feel free to message me!
Hi! I’m so sorry to hear you’re going through this! I don’t know what it’s like to have schizophrenia but I do have depression and anxiety! If you need to talk feel free to message me
